question: Can even vast material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth
This is contrasted with giving the teaching
inference: Even immense wealth is not a sufficient reason to give away the teaching.
uncertainties: akretuṃ is an unusual form, possibly for kartum or akartuṃ
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
